generationConstraints.allowedBoundary: Release verified against production JSON through L271.
imageRules: Generate square image / 1:1 composition for each sentence.
Use L058 lesson images only as illustration style references; do not copy any L058 person, clothing, face, hair, or body shape.
Use protagonist family identity anchors from L154/L162/L163 for protagonist mother, father, little girl, and older brother.
Every human prompt must explicitly name the role identity.
No written text, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, watermarks, logos, brands, wall writing, or readable marks.
Pretend sea-god mask play must be clearly child dress-up play, not a real religious ritual.
audioRules: Use repo OpenAI audio flow only.
Generate charAudio for 變 as public/assets/lessons/L271/audio/char-u8b8a.m4a from the single character.
Generate G02 prefix/suffix audio from exact text fragments.
Generate G05 wrong-option audio as standalone whole-text files from exact text.
Do not splice, cut, mute, patch, or extract production audio.

approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩在家休息很久後，精神變好了，坐起來或站起來看起來有精神，主角媽媽在旁邊微笑。不要做成嚴重醫療場景；不可有文字、數字、標籤或注音。
主角小女孩在安全空地或操場跑步，跑了一段時間後身體變好了，看起來更有力氣。主角爸爸在旁邊陪同；不可有跑道號碼、文字、數字、標籤或注音。

approvedSentences.text: 從早到晚打球，沒體力了。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 從早到晚打球沒體力了
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角哥哥從早到晚打球後，坐在球場邊休息，看起來沒體力了。旁邊可有球和球具，但不可有文字、數字、標籤或注音。
主角哥哥坐著或站著，看起來很沒精神，眼神疲累、動作慢，旁邊可有家人關心。人物身份是主角哥哥；不可有文字、數字、標籤或注音。

approvedSentences.text: 他戴上面具，就變海神了。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 他戴上面具就變海神了
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角哥哥戴上海神造型面具玩假裝遊戲，畫面要明確是孩子在玩扮演，不是真實宗教儀式。可有海浪、魚或大海想像布景；不可有文字、數字、標籤或注音。

stage4Plan.reason: 「身體變好了」是本課核心用法，目標字清楚。
